class.name: GearboxData
class.brief_description: Configuration data for a vehicle's gearbox and clutch.
class.description: GearboxData is a [Resource] that defines gear ratios, final drive ratio, and clutch maximum torque for a vehicle's drivetrain. Vehicle copies these values during initialization or [method Vehicle.restart]. [member auto_mode] is the initial/restart baseline; use [method Vehicle.set_gearbox_automatic] and [method Vehicle.get_gearbox_automatic] for live mode changes.

method.name: set_gear_ratios
method.description: Sets the array of gear ratios. Each entry represents a forward gear ratio. Higher ratios provide more torque at lower speeds.

method.name: get_gear_ratios
method.description: Returns the array of gear ratios.

method.name: set_final_drive
method.description: Sets the final drive ratio applied after the gearbox.

method.name: get_final_drive
method.description: Returns the final drive ratio.

method.name: set_clutch_max_torque
method.description: Sets the maximum torque the clutch can transmit in Nm.

method.name: get_clutch_max_torque
method.description: Returns the maximum torque the clutch can transmit in Nm.

method.name: set_reverse_ratio
method.description: Sets the reverse gear ratio. Should be a negative value for backward motion.

method.name: get_reverse_ratio
method.description: Returns the reverse gear ratio.

method.name: set_shift_time
method.description: Sets the gear-change timing value in seconds. Twenty percent of this value is used as the clutch-open gear-change dwell; clutch phase rates are configured separately with [member clutch_disengage_speed] and [member clutch_engage_speed].

method.name: get_shift_time
method.description: Returns the gear-change timing value in seconds; twenty percent is used as the clutch-open gear-change dwell.

method.name: set_clutch_engage_speed
method.description: Sets the clutch engagement phase rate in engagement fraction per second. Lower values make the engagement phase longer.

method.name: get_clutch_engage_speed
method.description: Returns the clutch engagement phase rate in engagement fraction per second.

method.name: set_clutch_disengage_speed
method.description: Sets the clutch disengagement phase rate in engagement fraction per second. Lower values make the disengagement phase longer.

method.name: get_clutch_disengage_speed
method.description: Returns the clutch disengagement phase rate in engagement fraction per second.

method.name: set_upshift_rpm
method.description: Sets the normalized engine-RPM ratio threshold for automatic upshifting. The value is interpreted within the engine idle-to-redline range.

method.name: get_upshift_rpm
method.description: Returns the normalized automatic upshift threshold.

method.name: set_downshift_rpm
method.description: Sets the normalized engine-RPM ratio threshold for automatic downshifting. The value is interpreted within the engine idle-to-redline range.

method.name: get_downshift_rpm
method.description: Returns the normalized automatic downshift threshold.

method.name: set_auto_mode
method.description: Sets the automatic/manual mode copied as the gearbox's initial and restart baseline. It does not change an already configured Vehicle until [method Vehicle.restart].

method.name: get_auto_mode
method.description: Returns the automatic/manual mode used as the gearbox's initial and restart baseline.

members.member: Array of forward gear ratios. Gear 1 uses index 0, gear 2 uses index 1, etc.
Maximum torque the clutch can transmit in Nm.
Reverse gear ratio. Negative value drives the vehicle backward.
Gear-change timing value in seconds. Twenty percent is used as the clutch-open gear-change dwell; it does not set clutch phase rates.
Clutch engagement rate in engagement fraction per second. Lower values make this phase longer.
Clutch disengagement rate in engagement fraction per second. Lower values make this phase longer.
Normalized engine-RPM ratio threshold for automatic upshifting.
Normalized engine-RPM ratio threshold for automatic downshifting.
Automatic/manual mode copied during Vehicle initialization or restart. Use [method Vehicle.set_gearbox_automatic] and [method Vehicle.get_gearbox_automatic] for live changes.
Rotational drag applied to the driveshaft. Higher values smooth out drivetrain oscillations and reduce overshoot.
